text: Rhino Whisky was founded by Gerrit Wagener and Brin Kushner - two South African friends who created the single-malt brand to fund rhino conservation through The Rhino Orphanage in Limpopo.
short: Rhino Whisky was founded by Gerrit Wagener and Brin Kushner.

source.name: Aspire Lifestyle (via Internet Archive): Rhino Whisky, distilled in Scotland with an African heart
source.quote: Its founders, Gerrit Wagener and Brin Kushner, worked with one of the oldest whisky producers in North-eastern Scotland
source.note: Live page returns 403 to scripts, so the archived copy of 2025-10-15 is cited.

additionalSources.name: Whisky of the Week (via Internet Archive): Rhino Whisky review and tasting notes
additionalSources.quote: Gerrit Wagener and Brin Kuchner (a qualified ranger) decided to create a whisky that would highlight the plight of the African rhino
additionalSources.note: Spelling disagreement: this review writes 'Kuchner'; Aspire Lifestyle and retail press write 'Kushner'.
